briefdescription.para: Encapsulates the aerodynamic calculations.

detaileddescription.para: This class owns and contains the list of force/coefficients that define the aerodynamic properties of an aircraft. Here also, such unique phenomena as ground effect, aerodynamic reference point shift, and maximum lift curve tailoff are handled.

Optionally two other coordinate systems may be used.
1) Body coordinate system: <axisname="{X|Y|Z}">
2) Axial-Normal coordinate system: <axisname="{AXIAL|NORMAL|SIDE}">
Systems may NOT be combined, or a load error will occur.
